# truefoundry_gateway_installation (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry gateway installation (`gateway-installation` manifest) — a self-hosted gateway plane registered on the control plane with the URL it serves (Settings → Gateway Endpoints).

On create, the provider mints the gateway's token, which the gateway plane uses as `TFY_API_KEY` to authenticate to the control plane. **The token is stored in the Terraform state** and fetched only once: an imported installation has no token, and replacing the installation mints a new one.

Import an existing installation by its name: `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_installation.example my-gateway`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A self-hosted gateway plane, registered on the control plane with the URL it
# serves.
resource "truefoundry_gateway_installation" "gateway_eu" {
  name = "gateway-eu"
  url  = "https://gateway.example.com"
}

# The gateway plane authenticates with the token as TFY_API_KEY. Hand it over
# through a secret store rather than reading it from the state.
resource "vault_kv_secret_v2" "gateway_token" {
  mount = "secret"
  name  = "tfy-llm-gateway/gateway-eu"
  data_json = jsonencode({
    TFY_API_KEY = truefoundry_gateway_installation.gateway_eu.token
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the gateway installation (3-35 characters; must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Changing it replaces the installation and mints a new token.
- `url` (String) Base URL the gateway plane is reachable at, e.g. https://gateway.example.com. Unique within the tenant.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the gateway endpoint is offered on the control plane, e.g. in the Playground. Defaults to true.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default gateway endpoint. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway installation.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token the gateway plane authenticates to the control plane with (its `TFY_API_KEY`). Minted once on create; null for imported installations.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Gateway installations are imported by their name. The token cannot be read
# back, so an imported installation has none; replace it to mint one.
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_installation.gateway_eu gateway-eu
```
